## Freed v26.10.701-dev

Enforce read-only Desktop viewers after Primary handoff, Linux Library credentials and repair release admission, and primary transfer remains disabled in ordinary builds. Synthetic handoff acceptance uses the separate signed transfer-acceptance app and a PWA built from the same release commit

### Features

- Enforce read-only Desktop viewers after Primary handoff
- Linux Library credentials and repair release admission
- Linux stores Library signing keys in an existing unlocked Secret Service vault and preserves the same identity across app and vault restarts

### Fixes

- Allow disabling automatic development sample data
- Allow bounded annotation transfer fixture retries
- Preserve normal Library startup in transfer previews
- Descriptions in media-free sidebar tiles now align correctly
- Locked or unavailable Linux vaults return an error instead of replacing Library keys
- Descriptions in sidebar tiles without media are centered
- Desktop Settings shows the ten newest individual releases with complete notes

### Follow-ups

- Fail the build when node_modules drifts from the lockfile
- Linux Library keys and transfer preview startup

### Downloads

**macOS:** `.dmg` (Apple Silicon or Intel, signed + notarized)  
**Windows:** `.exe` (NSIS installer)  
**Linux:** `.AppImage`  

> macOS downloads are signed and notarized for normal Gatekeeper installation.
